correctness.rationale: For all n>=2 and k in [1,2n], the four occupancy types (both,core,leaf,untouched) exhaust the possibilities. The strict improvement operation removes simultaneous both-led and untouched pairs. Schur elimination of unled leaves produces D−11^T with D_i=n or n+1 and Sherman–Morrison gives the exact inverse-trace expression. Below n, integer convexity and a strict penultimate-difference inequality narrow minimizers to one-core versus all-leaf classes; their objective difference has sign −T_n(k) with exact tie counts. At/above n, strict consecutive differences force all leaves led, including empty follower case k=2n. Independently exhaustively inverted grounded Laplacians using exact rational arithmetic for every leader set for n=2,3,4,5 and checked all budget optimizer types and counts. Root T_n near (sqrt(3)−1)n follows n-scaling.

originality.rationale: Known stochastic-consensus leader placement papers establish the objective, graph-specific path/cycle algorithms and other graph family exact allocations. Resultary published clique windmill, split-graph and complete bipartite leader results do not specialize to a clique with one private leaf at each core. No checked exact published corona table or dominating theorem supplies the four occupancy-class optimizers or the T_n sign transition. This remains a best-of-knowledge classification.
